note: One position, four different jobs: the shape over a slow click, its roots alone, the shape over a band, then free phrases that end on the root. Each block says which tool to start; the root stays lit in every view.

exercise.title: A minor pentatonic, position 1
exercise.focus: A minor pentatonic · position 1 · 60 then 80 bpm
exercise.why: Position 1 is the first scale shape most guitarists learn, since every note sits under four fingers at the 5th fret.

sections.text: Press Play on the click. Play position 1 from the low {{1}} up to the high E string. Then come back down, one note per click.
Now only the {{1}} notes are in play. Find all three A's on the neck. Hop between them in any order you like.
Press Play on the band: drums with bass at 80. Play the whole position again. Try starting from a different {{1}} each time.
Keep the band going. Play short phrases from the position, with a gap after each. End your phrases on a {{1}}. Any note in the position fits this backing.
